options.help:
Title

The title of the page. This is mostly used for organizational purposes as the SEO meta title field is used in the pages "title" tag. 

Permalink

This is the desired URL path to this page. It must ALWAYS start with a forward slash and contain only URL compatible characters (you must remove spaces). For instance if our page is called "Test Page" we could use /test-page for the permalink value. You could then access the page at https://familyforestcarbon.org/test-page.

Status

You will see this field on most content items in the CMS. The status field represents the current state of the particular item and how/if it will appear on the website. The DRAFT status means the item will appear on the preview website but not the production website. PUBLISHED means the item will appear on both the preview and production website. Items with the ARCHIVED status means the item won't appear on either website, it's meant for content you aren't using anymore but don't want to delete.

Blocks

The blocks section is where you can create new or select existing sections of content, referred to as "blocks", to create various page layouts. There is no limit to the number and type of blocks you can add to this section. You can easily control the order in which these content blocks appear by simply dragging and dropping the blocks into the desired order.

To edit individual blocks you can click on them and a fly out menu will open over top the current page so you can make updates to teh block without ever leaving the context of it's parent page.

SEO

This is where all SEO information about the page is contained.
